verdict.rationale: The video docs say it turns text prompts into short videos and lets users refine results across multiple turns via the Interactions API, including conversational edits such as element replacement and perspective changes. Hands-on community reports confirm that text-to-video generation works, though prompt adherence is imperfect. The iteration claim, however, sits beside a migration notice pointing to Gemini Omni Flash, so it is unclear which model the multi-turn refinement belongs to, and no hands-on report confirms it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-turn refinement, in-depth docs on the iteration workflow, clarity that this refinement is a Veo capability rather than a successor model's.
